calls.title: Jay Janarthanan and Dan Wathne
calls.summary: Jay Janarthanan (buyer) and Dan Wathne (sales rep) discussed Growthbook's Pro vs Enterprise plans, with Jay noting Enterprise is more cost-effective for their usage and requires managed warehouse and rollback features. Dan highlighted Enterprise provides better support and future-proofing, while a pricing discount (from $37K to $29.6K) is contingent on signing within the quarter. Next steps: Jay will propose a 30-day opt-out clause to his CEO/Jack to lock in the discount, or arrange a leadership call if needed, with Dan updating the order form and awaiting a decision within the next two weeks.
